name: Retrocalcaneal Bursitis
definition: Inflammation of the retrocalcaneal bursa between the Achilles tendon and posterior calcaneus, often coexisting with insertional Achilles pathology.

investigations.principle: Usually clinical; ultrasound or MRI may help when persistent or atypical.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, tendon, cartilage, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Injection requires caution because of Achilles tendon proximity.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

patientEducation.summary: Inflammation of the retrocalcaneal bursa between the Achilles tendon and posterior calcaneus, often coexisting with insertional Achilles pathology.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, severe deformity, progressive weakness, tendon rupture, infection or other listed red flags.
